title: Button Bounce and Debounce Visualizer
description: A real button does not go cleanly from released (1) to pressed (0): its contacts bounce for a few milliseconds. The debounce rule from test 03 accepts a change only when the pin state differs from the accepted state and more than the debounce time has passed since the last accepted change.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Study Buddy
Buttons, State Machines, and Device Modes
Bounce
Button Debouncing
Debounce Time
Falling Edge Detection
ticks_diff

learningObjectives: The learner will execute the debounce rule on 6 recorded pin traces by counting the presses accepted at a given debounce time, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt.
prerequisites: bounce, debounce time, falling edge, `ticks_diff` (all defined in the sections above this block). The debounce rule is shown in the Rules field and on screen throughout.

accessibility.notes: describe() provides a screen-reader description; all controls are native HTML elements.

userInterface.layoutPattern: drawing region above a control region

controls.name: Start the 6 items / Back to explore
controls.purpose: Switch between exploring trace B and the six-item quiz.

controls.name: Answer box and Submit
controls.purpose: Type the number of presses the rule counts and submit (Enter also submits). One attempt per item.

controls.name: Debounce time slider
controls.purpose: Explore only: 0 to 100 ms in steps of 10 ms, default 30 ms.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore, then fixed-order practice items with one attempt each and immediate explained feedback
keyQuestions: Item 4 used 100 ms and item 5 used 30 ms. Which was too long and which was too short?
Why does the rule need debouncing on release as well as on press (item 6)?
What debounce time would count trace D as two presses and trace E as one?
commonMisconceptions: (1) Every 0 in the trace is a separate press. (2) A longer debounce time is always safer. (3) Debouncing is only needed when a button is pressed, not when it is released.
assessmentOpportunities: Complete all six items. Mastery is 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt.
